C_COD_NAMES_THE_MISCOMPUTATION.rationale: The response explicitly identifies the discount-versus-price miscomputation with exact formulas and numbers, but it does not explicitly name who loses money (the business/seller), falling just short of the level 5 anchor.

C_COD_TIERS_UNCHANGED.rationale: The response keeps the module's stated tiers and percentages intact (standard: 20%, premium: 30%) and clearly distinguishes the discount amount from the remainder when walking through an example.
